summary: Iteration 51 verified end-to-end on Expo web preview (mobile viewport 390x844) as Maggie. All three polish items landed successfully: (1) butterfly animation fires on both Friends sendFlutter and Home flutterBack — 9 absolute-positioned Animated.View butterflies detected in DOM immediately after each emit call (emitFlutter(5) spawn + prior state), URL remained on /friends and /home respectively (no auth bounce); (2) redesigned Home flutter card renders 36px AvatarBubble, bold sender name, 'Tap to see their profile' hint and chevron on a dedicated Pressable row that navigates correctly to /user/<from_id>; (3) Invite Friends share sheet close (X) button now a visible 44x44 circle with border (borderRadius 22px, background #FFFFFF, borderColor rgb(203,213,225)), and the new bottom 'Cancel' pill (testID share-cancel) dismisses the modal. Toasts 'Flutter sent to <name>!' displayed on both flows. No regressions observed on friends/home nav. Non-blocking console warnings observed on web-only (useNativeDriver fallback, deprecated shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents props) — expected on RN Web.

react_native_issues.issue: useNativeDriver: true logs a JS-fallback warning on RN Web ('RCTAnimation module missing'). Cosmetic only — animation still runs. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/FlutterOverlay.tsx:96-107

'shadow*' and 'textShadow*' style props deprecated in RN Web; should migrate to boxShadow/textShadow shorthand. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/FlutterOverlay.tsx:156-158 (textShadow*), /app/frontend/src/components/ShareYouBelong.tsx:486-488, 527 (shadow*)
FlutterOverlay uses <View pointerEvents="none">; RN Web recommends style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/FlutterOverlay.tsx:76

action_items: OPTIONAL polish: move pointerEvents="none" into style on FlutterOverlay to silence the RN Web deprecation warning.
OPTIONAL polish: migrate remaining shadow*/textShadow* style props to boxShadow/textShadow shorthand (non-blocking; only affects console noise on web).
critical_code_review_comments: FlutterOverlay cleanup is correct — spawned butterflies are filtered out via setTimeout with a duration that accounts for delay + animation length. No leak observed.
emitFlutter listener catch-blocks prevent one bad subscriber from breaking others — good defensive pattern.
home.tsx flutterBack correctly removed refresh() call as documented; auth session remained intact across the flutter-back click (verified in test).
ShareYouBelong close button now has explicit 44x44 minimum touch target with visible surfaceSecondary bg + border — meets accessibility guidelines.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Existing Maggie inbox already contained flutters from previous iterations, so the redesigned card + flutterBack animation could both be verified against live data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Butterfly animation verified via DOM sampling — the FlutterOverlay renders <Animated.View> children with position:absolute and the 🦋 emoji. On RN Web, useNativeDriver falls back to JS animation (warning is expected, not an error).
